meta.notes: Defines the sound event msm_examples:music_disc.night_drive. It plays the vanilla file records/cat for now: choose Import assets, then Sounds, and pick your own .ogg (for example night_drive.ogg; it is stored as sounds/night_drive.ogg in this namespace), then change name to msm_examples:night_drive. stream: true plays long music without loading it all at once.
